purpose: Validate semantic integration of the locked ANL64 planner + 140 Q4_FAST decode nodes against the exact frozen safe ArcLLM reference before any matched performance confirmation.

frozen_repetitions.reason: Reuse the exact locked runtime repetition contract; do not modify production source merely to reduce validation cost.

pass_requires: candidate P4 executable SHA256 or exact rebuild bound to locked sources

F1_structure.candidate_plan_hash_requirement: nonzero and identical across W-S and W-C processes

F2_prefill_control.rule: For every measured attempt, generated_token_ids[0] must be exactly equal between ARC_SAFE_REFERENCE and ANL64_P4_LOCKED for the same workload.
F2_prefill_control.rationale: Prefill remains on the unchanged safe path; a mismatch is an integration/control failure independent of Q4_FAST decode semantics.

F3_decode_semantics.rule: For each workload and measured attempt index 0..4, the complete 32-token generated_token_ids sequence must be exactly equal between candidate and reference.
F3_decode_semantics.rationale: Closed SA1 already established local numerical correctness of the exact Q4_FAST shader. P5 tests integrated greedy execution semantics; full-logit bit identity is not expected under changed FP32 reduction order.

F4_repeatability.rule: Within each system/workload, all five measured generated-token sequences must be identical; candidate final logits hash and final hidden hash must each be stable across the five measured attempts.

stop_rules: Any measured candidate/reference token mismatch => P5_SEMANTIC_INTEGRATION_FAIL; do not tune thresholds or Q4_FAST.
Any candidate structural census/finite/dispatch failure => P5_SEMANTIC_INTEGRATION_FAIL unless independently proven F0 infrastructure/provenance.
No Q6 optimization, fusion, repack, prefetch, quantization change, executor search or numerical threshold tuning is allowed as P5 rescue.
A semantic FAIL closes the current ANL64 architecture path before P6.
A valid P5 PASS only makes P6 specification/authorization eligible; it does not authorize performance execution automatically.

infrastructure_policy.repair_scope: infrastructure/orchestration only; no production/runtime/shader/science contract mutation
infrastructure_policy.after_partial_scientific_execution: full frozen P5 replay only if the sole repair is validly adjudicated infrastructure-only
